taz.title: Flucht und Klimawandel: Ein Klima der Krisen

metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract: epa12712382 A Kenyan police reservist (C) is reflected in a mirror during a relief food distribution in drought-hit Nadunga village, Turkana North, Kenya, 06 February 2026 (issued 07 February 2026). World Vision Kenya, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP) and in collaboration with the National and County Governments of Turkana, is providing life-saving food assistance to mitigate the impact of the ongoing drought. The intervention reaches the most vulnerable households across Turkana North, Central, South, and East through 24 distribution centres, providing timely access to nutritious food for approximately 51,150 people (8,525 households). The drought in Kenya, particularly across arid and semi-arid counties, remains severe, with prolonged below-average rainfall causing food insecurity, water scarcity, and livestock losses, highlighting the urgent need for continued support.  EPA/DANIEL IRUNGU
